TSS-0046: No IMO Part I system covers the area (P-S6; WETREP north-eastern limit is the line B/NL border to 52 12'N UK coast, far to the south-west, P-S5). The Dutch legal vehicle for reporting systems outside the territorial sea (P-S16) has one implementing regulation, which contains routeing measures only and no reporting system (P-S17). Pass 4: Scheepvaartreglement territoriale zee art. 5(1) requires ships of 300 GT or more, or carrying dangerous goods, to report before entering the Dutch territorial sea; this is made as the VTS or approach-area arrival report and is not a separate ship reporting system.

Offshore EEZ scheme north of the Wadden Islands. Mandatory reporting: none (Part I and Dutch EEZ regulation checked). VTS: none found; VTS Off Texel boundary excludes it; no official complete list of Dutch VTS areas was found to prove absence.
COLREG.2/Circ.66/Corr.1 20 May 2016; BaZ 261(P)/25 9 Oct 2025; BWBR0033648 version 6 Jul 2022

VTS absence not proven by an official complete list of Dutch VTS areas; eastern end of the scheme relative to German Bight Traffic (German VTS) not checked; coordinates of the eastern end not retrieved.
TSS-0047: Outside all Part I systems (P-S6; WETREP limit line runs 51 22'N 003 22'E to 52 12'N UK coast, P-S5). Dutch EEZ routeing and reporting regulation contains no reporting system (P-S16, P-S17). Circ.59 recommends this western route to deep-draught tankers exempted from the southern mandatory tanker route and asks for a log entry only (P-S4): routeing, not reporting. Pass 4: Scheepvaartreglement territoriale zee art. 5(1) requires ships of 300 GT or more, or carrying dangerous goods, to report before entering the Dutch territorial sea; this is made as the VTS or approach-area arrival report and is not a separate ship reporting system.
Offshore scheme on the western deep-draught route. No mandatory reporting. No VTS found; VTS Off Texel does not reach it. Absence of VTS not proven by a complete official list.
COLREG.2/Circ.59 31 Oct 2007; BaZ week 41 2025; BWBR0033648 version 6 Jul 2022
